# 1 Enoch Chapter 57 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**57:1** And-I-saw and-behold! Hosts of-angels, even-the-host of-clouds of-light, issuing from-that-place, and-light and-dew-drops drenching that-host, and [other] hosts of-light proceeding.

**57:2** And-after this I-saw those-very-hosts carrying with-them a-golden crown, and-there-was the-appearance [of men]. And-I-asked the-angel of-peace who-was with-me, and-I-said: What-is this?

**57:3** And-he-said unto-me: These are-going to-the-children of-the-elect and-righteous, and-they shall-be the-heirs of-all this. And-peace shall-be their-lot on-the-face of-the-earth, and-they shall-be planted in-it, and-these [hosts] will-come-down from-heaven, and-there will-be the-sound of-the-hosts, and-they-will-fill-up the-face of-the-earth. And-the-host shall-descend and-stand before-them.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Hyphenated compounds preserve Ge'ez construct chains. Ch. 57 is a brief transitional vision of angelic hosts bearing golden crowns to the elect — a counterpoint to the armies of punishment in ch. 56. The vision of 'children of the elect and righteous' inheriting the earth echoes Matt 5:5.*
